confidentiality.example: Confidential - for Audit Committee use only

executive_summary.desc: What was reviewed and the overall conclusion
executive_summary.example: Internal Audit reviewed the procurement-to-payment process across three business units. Controls are generally in place, but weaknesses in PO approval and contract monitoring expose the company to unauthorised spending.

key_highlights.desc: Most important observations, good and bad
key_highlights.example:
12% of purchase orders were approved after the invoice date
3 active vendors had no valid contract on file
Payment approval controls operated effectively

audit_scope.example: Vendor onboarding, PO approval, contract management, invoice matching and payments for Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand.

conclusion.example: Management has agreed to all recommendations. Internal Audit will follow up on high-risk findings in Q1 2027.

findings[].title.example:
Purchase orders raised after goods were received
Expired vendor contracts still in active use
Users can both create vendors and approve payments

findings[].recommendation.example:
Block invoices without an approved PO
Set contract expiry alerts 90 days ahead
Remove conflicting access; review quarterly

findings[].owner.example:
Head of Procurement
Legal & Procurement
IT Security
